author: Derryck Bartlett
html: Hi. I am planning this very trip and found your page. Thanks for making such a cool page and writings. I see at the start you went from France to Switzerland. Is there no flatter way across Europe? Or do you not feel the hills eventually? Also, would it not be easier to go through Russia so that there are less VISAs to obtain? Or would it be too cold? Thanks 😁

author: Basile
html:
Yes, you can go through flatter lands, I went through CH because I’m swiss 🙂
And yes, Russia might be easier visa-wise, but more uniform culturally;) Happy to answer any more questions you might have through instagram : @basileslife ! Good luck on your journey !
